# Exception model: use /EHa globally so that _set_se_translator works in SDK code
# (REContext.cpp, RETypeDB.cpp use ScopedTranslator to catch hardware exceptions
# like access violations from the game's anti-tamper code). /EHsc silently disables
# this mechanism, causing uncatchable crashes. /EHa is slightly slower but safe.

set(DYNAMIC_LOADER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

set(FT_DISABLE_HARFBUZZ ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE) # Freetype

if ("${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}" MATCHES "Release")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} /MT")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} /MT")

    # Statically compile runtime
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/MD" "/MT" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/MD" "/MT" CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/MD" "/MT" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/MD" "/MT" CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE}")

    # Aggressive optimization flags
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE} /O2 /Gw /GF /Oi /fp:fast")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE} /O2 /Gw /GF /Oi /fp:fast")

    message(NOTICE "Building in Release mode with LTCG + max optimization")
    set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION TRUE)
    set(CMAKE_INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION_RELEASE TRUE)
endif()

		sol2
		imgui
	)

		RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE

		ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE
			"${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib/${CMKR_TARGET}"
		ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO
			"${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib/${CMKR_TARGET}"
	)

endif()
